requirements.requirement: Smallest build that holds one bin
requirements.evidence: Built 2-part single-cell build: piece:0,0,0;half-e (Hex base · East half, 196g) + bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-half-e-third (Bin, east half, third depth, 36.8mm deep). Total 255g / 369min. Verified by check_build meshClash clear. No smaller is possible: quarter bases accept no bin sockets (tested), so a half base is the minimum footprint; third depth is the shallowest bin available for that base. House rules capOpenFaces/lockJoints intentionally omitted per instructions for 'smallest' briefs.

finish.summary: Smallest possible: single east-half base with one third-depth half bin. 1 base + 1 bin = 2 parts, 255g, mesh clear. Quarter bases cannot hold bins, so half-cell is the minimum.

events.text: Your smallest bin holder — I'll make the tiniest frame that can carry it.
